evidence: The amount 19,758 is not printed anywhere as one figure: it is the sum of three fund-schedule rows that all print the same wording, 'Homestead exemption'. Bassett_FY2022 p24, CDBG Fund schedule: REVENUES / Intergovernmental / 'State sources' / 'Grant' 18,400. On p5 the governmental funds statement prints 18,400 in the CDBG Fund column of the 'Intergovernmental' row; the separate 'Federal grants' row is blank in the CDBG column (47,786 only in the ARPA Fund). Two rules point different ways: the row is printed under a State heading (state aid), while the fund is named after a federal programme, CDBG (federal grants). The heading printed directly over this row says State sources and the report keeps it out of its Federal grants row, so state aid; a reader applying the fund-name rule would say federal grants.

Bassett_FY2022 p24, CDBG Fund schedule: REVENUES / Intergovernmental / 'State sources' / 'Grant', 2022 column 18,400. Printed under the State sources heading; the statement (p5) leaves the CDBG column of its 'Federal grants' row blank. Conflict with the fund name (CDBG is a federal programme) as for id 45: the printed heading over the row is taken as deciding.
